patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: Information available to the player before assigning a room. This is the only detailed-patient section exposed before the first assignment.
presentation.quote: I thought it was the burrito, but this pressure started at my desk and now it goes into my jaw. I am sweating through my shirt. I still have that meeting at three.
presentation.triageNote: 58-year-old man with ongoing substernal pressure that began while seated at his desk and now radiates to the jaw. He appears pale and diaphoretic; heart rate is 108.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. The player's assigned room is session state and is not stored in the patient record.

clinical._comment: Display-ready educational explanation of why the correct ESI applies, using only evidence in patient.presentation. Used by Coach and Patient Review after the answer is available; does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This is a high-risk chest-pain presentation that requires rapid cardiac evaluation before a benign gastrointestinal cause can be considered safe.
clinical.acuityReason: Ongoing substernal pressure with jaw radiation, diaphoresis, and tachycardia may represent a time-sensitive cardiac event even though the patient calls it heartburn.
expectedResources: IV access and cardiac laboratory testing
clinical.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because suspicious active chest discomfort is high risk and should not wait for a resource-based lower-acuity assignment.
keyFindings: Symptoms began while seated at a desk
redFlags: Active chest pressure with jaw radiation
teachingPoints: A patient's label of heartburn does not make a high-risk chest-pain pattern low acuity.
ESI 2 is assigned for a time-sensitive high-risk presentation, not because a final cardiac diagnosis is already known.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: The patient would receive immediate ECG and monitored cardiac evaluation, with antiplatelet therapy and urgent cardiology intervention if the evaluation supports acute coronary ischemia.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 58-year-old man in a rumpled work shirt, tie loosened
aiImageGeneration.pose: hunched slightly forward, one hand resting flat on the center of his chest
aiImageGeneration.expression: uneasy, jaw tight, a sheen of sweat on his forehead
signs: hand pressed to center of chest
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: insists he's fine, but plainly looks unwell
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 58-year-old man in a rumpled work shirt with a loosened tie, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: hunched slightly forward, one hand resting flat on the center of his chest. Expression: uneasy and unwell, quiet worry, jaw tight (not a big grimace). Clearly visible: beads of sweat on his forehead (diaphoretic), slightly gray washed-out skin, hand pressed to the center of his chest. Overall insists he's fine but plainly looks unwell. No text, no logos.
